from pocket_coffea.lib.hist_manager import Axis, HistogramConfiguration

variables = {
    "muon_pt": HistogramConfiguration(
        axes=[
            Axis(
                name="pt",
                bins=60,
                start=0,
                end=300,
                label="Muon pT [GeV]"
            )
        ]
    )
}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    config = variables["muon_pt"]
    axis = config.axes[0]
    print(f"Histogram configuration created:")
    print(f"  Name: muon_pt")
    print(f"  Axis: {axis.name}")
    print(f"  Bins: {axis.bins}")
    print(f"  Range: [{axis.start}, {axis.end}]")
    print(f"  Label: {axis.label}")
